items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to central high school districts in the county of Suffolk
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2991

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the education law, in relation to
central high school districts in the county of Suffolk

 PURPOSE :

Provides that the territory of central high school districts that
merge in the county of Suffolk does not need to be contiguous.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1912 of the education law is amended to provide that the
formation of central high school districts in the county of Suffolk
that may be formed by the combination of two or more of the following
central, union free or common school districts in the county of
Suffolk need not be contiguous: Montauk, Amagansett, East Hampton,
East Moriches, Springs, Wainscott, Sagaponack, Bridgehampton, Sag
Harbor, Southampton, Tuckahoe, Hampton Bays, Riverhead, Quogue, East
Quogue, Westhampton Beach and Remsenburg-Speonk

 JUSTIFICATION :

Section 1912 of the education laws allows central high school
districts in Suffolk County to be formed by the combination of two or
more central, union free or common school districts. The current law,
however, precludes districts whose territories are not contiguous from
creating a central high school district. This bill provides that the
following school districts within Suffolk County need not be
contiguous to allow them to consider merging to create a central highs
school district: Montauk, Amagansett, East Hampton, East Moriches,
Springs, Wainscott, Sagaponack, Bridgehampton, Sag Harbor,
Southampton, Tuckahoe, Hampton Bays, Riverhead, Quogue, East Quogue,
Westhampton Beach and Remsenburg-Speonk.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2015-16 S.1442A/A.1414A;
2013-14 S.2281/A.2389;
2011-12 S.3555/A.5671;
2009-10 S. 1774/A.6823;
2007-08, S .8110/A.10723.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Provides that the territory of central high school districts that merge in the county of Suffolk does not need to be contiguous in certain circumstances.
